author: rasjh
quote:
The review bombing is honestly embarrassing. 

GTA 6 is one of the best game ever made .

At first Control was my favourite game this year. Then I played GTA 6.I think the moment I realised GTA 6 was not just a game was when I saw a plane crashing while I was driving. No quest marker, no notification, nothing. I just saw the smoke in the distance, decided to follow it, and drove all the way across the map.When I got there, I discovered it was a plane carrying drugs. I collected them, only for a bunch of criminals to suddenly show up and attack me. I killed them, and by this point I was genuinely amazed by what had just happened.I literally stopped playing, called my friends and started telling them what had happened. And while I was on the phone, the police and firefighters actually arrived at the crash site. I had to get the hell out of there before things got even **** the crazy part? None of this was part of a mission. I wasn’t following a quest or doing anything the game told me to do. I just happened to be driving, saw something happening in the world, and decided to investigate.That’s when it hit me. GTA 6 isn’t just giving you missions to complete. It’s creating stories for you to experience without even asking. 

Gta 6 feels doesn’t feel like a game it feels like a different reality where I’m living a different life doing the evil things I always wanted to do .
